specification.objective: Resolve the confirmed project/tasks rendering defect by moving the project Kanban out of ProjectTasksPage into a dedicated responsive Kanban screen. Preserve existing Kanban domain/API/authorization behavior, expose the dedicated screen through workspace navigation, and keep the Kanban board outside the shell's outer vertical scroll so its reorderable views own their scrolling surface.

requirements.statement: ProjectTasksPage must remain free of KanbanBoardView construction and Kanban-specific dialogs/actions.
A dedicated ProjectKanbanPage must render project selection and the existing KanbanBoardView for the selected project.
Workspace navigation must expose a Kanban destination that opens ProjectKanbanPage without changing existing destinations.
WorkspaceScaffold must support a non-scrollable content mode while preserving the current scrollable mode as the default for existing pages.
ProjectKanbanPage must use non-scrollable WorkspaceScaffold content so horizontal column reordering and vertical card reordering are not nested inside the shell's vertical SingleChildScrollView.
Kanban column/card creation, edit, delete, movement, column reorder, and assignee management must remain wired to ProjectTasksController and existing API semantics.
Task/card editor behavior shared by project tasks and Kanban must be implemented once in a reusable ProjectTaskEditorDialog rather than duplicated.
KanbanBoardView must fill a bounded parent height instead of imposing a fixed 560 pixel board height, so the dedicated screen remains usable on narrow/mobile web viewports.
The locked Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-kanban-page-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: ProjectTasksPage source no longer contains _buildKanbanWorkspace or Kanban-specific dialog/action methods, while its existing projects/tasks workspace remains present.
ProjectKanbanPage exists, uses WorkspaceScaffold with contentScrollable false, presents a project selector, and renders KanbanBoardView for loaded board state.
Workspace drawer contains a Kanban item that navigates to ProjectKanbanPage and existing navigation items remain present.
KanbanBoardView uses an Expanded board viewport and no fixed height 560 container.
Dedicated Kanban page wires all existing board callbacks to ProjectTasksController operations and uses shared ProjectTaskEditorDialog for create/edit card flows.
Frontend widget tests cover dedicated Kanban rendering on wide and narrow viewports and WorkspaceScaffold non-scrollable content mode.
The locked schema-v4 contract is included under docs/contracts/project-kanban-page-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: Backend models, database schema, API routes, authorization rules, Kanban versioning, and persistence are unchanged.
Existing ProjectTasksController Kanban operations and optimistic concurrency behavior are preserved.
Existing workspace pages remain scrollable because WorkspaceScaffold contentScrollable defaults to true.
No new Flutter package or drag-and-drop dependency is introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: ProjectKanbanPage is wrapped by the shell's outer vertical SingleChildScrollView.
Task/card editor UI is independently duplicated between ProjectTasksPage and ProjectKanbanPage.
Existing workspace pages lose their default scroll behavior.

inputs.statement: Authenticated manager or project-member employee opens the Kanban destination on desktop or narrow/mobile Flutter Web viewport.
User selects a project and performs permitted Kanban operations using the existing controller/API contracts.

outputs.statement: Dedicated responsive Kanban screen with project selection and bounded board viewport.
Project/tasks management screen remains stable and does not construct the Kanban subtree.

failure_semantics.statement: If the dedicated page, non-scroll shell mode, navigation entry, bounded Kanban viewport, or shared task editor is missing, validation fails closed with project_kanban_page_missing.
